The '''invasion of Ryloth''' was fought in [[22 BBY]] between [[Wat Tambor]]'s [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] forces against the [[Twi'lek Resistance]] and the [[Outer Rim garrison|Ryloth garrison]]. The [[garrison]] was quickly overrun, and Tambor claimed all of [[Ryloth]].<ref name="OTFL" />
